testcase.name: Scenario: Open the Modify command list on the floating ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:79:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open the Modify command list on the floating ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected ✔ When the user selects the Modify group button ✔ Then the Modify button is highlighted blue ✔ And an adjacent command list opens with Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, and other Modify commands ✔ When the user selects a face in the viewport outside the command list ✔ Then the command list closes ✔ And the face is highlighted with a one-face selection indicator ✔ When the user clicks empty workspace outside the part ✔ Then the face selection clears ✔ And the ribbon remains floating
